minutes_briefs.title: BC vehicle insurance rules change October 19, 2026: new licence and driving-history definitions take effect
minutes_briefs.summary: BC Regulation 134/2026 brings parts of the Motor Vehicle Amendment Act, 2025 into force on October 19, 2026. It updates several insurance and motor vehicle regulations, including the Basic Vehicle Damage Coverage Regulation and the Insurance (Vehicle) Regulation. The changes add new definitions for 'compliant driving history', 'graduation date', 'new Class 5 graduate' and 'new resident Class 5 holder' in the Motor Vehicle Act Regulations. These definitions affect how driving experience is counted for new drivers and new residents.
minutes_briefs.action_required: If you employ drivers or manage a fleet, review your driver records and insurance paperwork before October 19, 2026 to confirm how the new driving-history definitions apply.

key_dates.label: BC vehicle insurance regulation changes take effect
